For the **Saber extension-to-crankshaft bolts**, the listed torque depends on bolt diameter:

- **3/8 in.: 30–35 ft-lb**
- **7/16 in.: 35–45 ft-lb**
- **1/2 in.: 40–50 ft-lb** [2]

Don’t confuse this with the **prop-to-extension bolts**: their torque is specified by the propeller manufacturer and may differ. [1] Check the applicable Saber and propeller instructions for your installation.
